title: Affine local lifting of fixed-model maps
statement: Let $I$ be a directed preorder, $R:I\to\mathrm{CommRing}$ a functor with Noetherian rings $R_k$, and $c$ a limit cone of $R^{\mathrm{op}}\circ\operatorname{Spec}$ with affine vertex $S$. Fix $i\in I$ and a quasi-compact, quasi-separated, locally finitely presented morphism $f:X_i\to\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)$ [def-pc-scheme]. Put $X=X_i\times_{\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)} S$, and $X_j=X_i\times_{\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)}\operatorname{Spec}(R_j)$ for $j\geq i$ [def-pc-base-change]. Fix $j\geq i$, finitely presented quasi-coherent modules $F_j,G_j$ on $X_j$ [pqf-def-coherent], and a map $\varphi:(F_j)_X\to(G_j)_X$. Write X_k for the base change of X_i to Spec R_k. For each k ≥ j, let A denote tensor pullback from X_j to X_k, B tensor pullback from X_k to X, and e the canonical comparison from direct tensor pullback to A followed by B [def-pc-tensor-pullback-composition-iso]. There are a later stage k, a finite affine open cover U of X_k, and a family of component maps r_a between the restrictions of A F_j and A G_j. Under the canonical restriction/tensor pullback comparison [def-pc-open-cover-tensor-pullback-comparison], their pullbacks to the limit recover e_F inverse followed by phi followed by e_G. No overlap compatibility is required.

source.place: Tag 01ZR, first proof, affine lifting and Zariski gluing; Algebra Tag 05N7

proof.text: Use quasi-compactness of the base-changed structure morphism over Spec Rj to obtain CompactSpace Xj. Choose Xj.affineCover.finiteSubcover. Every chart is affine by the Mathlib instance for a finite subcover of an affine cover.
For each chart apply finitePresentation_one_chart_map_lift_eventually to the supplied finite affine cover, the two models and the limit map. Choose its stage and its eventual chart lifting assertion.

The finite set formed by j and the image of the chart stages has an upper bound l by Finset.exists_le. Pull the chosen cover back along the transition map to l. Its index type is still finite, and its charts are affine because the transition map is an affine base change of Spec.map. Construct e explicitly as tensorPullbackCompositionIso; its canonicality clause is reflexivity. Apply each eventual assertion at l, choose the resulting component map and combine the family with its recovery equations. This proves the displayed existential conclusion. In the empty-cover case the finite set still contains j, so the bound exists and the family of chart maps is empty.
